title: Lyft and Baidu enter London’s robotaxi battleground as testing begins
slides: Lyft and Baidu enter London’s robotaxi test—who leads?
Both firms received permits for limited public road trials.
Waymo already operates nearby, but lacks UK approval yet.
You may soon hail a driverless ride in central zones.
Check which operator runs near your route this month.
thread_text:
Who's really ahead?

Lyft and Baidu both got permits for limited public road trials in London.

Waymo is already testing nearby.

But the US giant still lacks UK approval for its own fleet.

Limited permits mean small zones.

You may soon hail a driverless ride only in central areas.

The real race is regulatory.

Each operator needs more than a permit to scale across London.

Check which operator runs near your route this month.

Open the city's transport map and look for trial zones.
